name: Ugan
source: A bodyguard that works at the mansion. Previously lived in the kingdom of Tumia and thus cannot speak Japanese. Likes cute slender boys and believes all Japanese people look the same. Likewise only Mizoguchi can tell the difference between Sabo and Ugan.
